1.

From Egypt God has called His people: "Let My Son go!" His word to Pharaoh. The same call now also for us has resounded, God in the wilderness among His people will dwell. May we, free from the house of bondage, Serve Him who first served us, Follow God, who now has stepped forth in the light, Given salvation, that we may not perish.

2.

The law’s demand no longer frightens us, We are set free through the law of the Spirit; The soul’s gaze freely reaches to Christ, We may walk here to God’s pleasure. May we, saved from Moab’s snares, Follow the ark through Jordan’s flood To God’s land, despite hindrances, need, and perils, He Himself thereto gives strength and courage!

3.

God gives His whole armour, And in the conflict He Himself is near us. He who fights and remains in prayer, Meets "the Prince of the Lord’s host." In the evil day he overcomes, Ever in God’s will he stands; In God’s temple he shall find his place As a pillar and shall not go out.
